purpose: Teach: ヴァン/タナ/サーキット/アロマ/ウルトラマン/エヴァ/ドス/ゴキブリ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヴァン・ヘイレンのギターがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer said he loves Van Halen's guitar playing.
lines.style: Soft conspiratorial lean-in, gentle smile in the voice, unhurried, savoring the little detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの名前をタナちゃんって付けたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei-chan, they told me they named their pet Tana-chan.
lines.style: Bright answering warmth, light laugh tucked under the first words, melodic and easy throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、F1のサーキット観戦に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently they went to watch F1 live at the circuit.
lines.style: Quiet wonder on the F1 detail, eyebrows-raised lift mid-line, soft unhurried finish.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アロマセラピーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei-chan, they said they're really into aromatherapy too.
lines.style: Warm knowing nod in the voice, gentle rise on the hobby, settling softly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ウルトラマンの怪獣図鑑を集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they said they collect Ultraman monster encyclopedias, of all things.
lines.style: Delighted hush, as if sharing a small secret, amused stress on the collection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エヴァ、つまりエヴァンゲリオンの新作を観に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei-chan, they went to see the new Eva — Evangelion, that is.
lines.style: Playful emphasis on the little correction, small chuckle behind it, warm relaxed pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ドスの効いた声で笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, they were laughing in this deep, gravelly voice the whole time.
lines.style: Giggling undertone, dropping her own voice low to imitate, then softening back up.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゴキブリ駆除の苦労話を笑顔で語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei-chan, they told me their whole cockroach-extermination saga — smiling all the way through it.
lines.style: Fond disbelief, smiling through the whole line, gentle laugh escaping on the ending.
